description: This file defines kernel packages for the Broadcom 2835 SPI controller drivers, including their configuration options, files, dependencies, and descriptions. It uses a domain-specific syntax for defining kernel modules in the OpenWrt build system.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-bcm2835
methods.description: Defines the Broadcom BCM2835 SPI driver package with configuration and build info.
